question.text: What powers does the Director of FIU-IND have under Section 13(2) of PMLA?

answer.text: Power to impose fines on banking companies, financial institutions or intermediaries for failing to maintain records or furnish information
Power to arrest persons suspected of money laundering
Power to freeze all assets of any financial institution
Power to revoke the license of any bank

explanation.text: The Logic: Under Section 13(2) of PMLA, the Director of FIU-IND may impose a fine on any banking company, financial institution, or intermediary for failures to maintain records, furnish information, or verify the identities of clients. The Trap: The other options describe powers that are not granted to the Director of FIU-IND under Section 13(2); the section is limited to imposing fines for the specified compliance failures. Note: Section 13 also gives the Director civil court-like powers (for example to compel production of records) in relation to these proceedings.
